_comment: Line coverage says a line ran. It does not say an assertion would have noticed
if that line were wrong — and in a kit that computes what a person receives for
their money, that gap is the one that matters. Stryker rewrites the code in small
ways (a > becomes a >=, a + becomes a -) and reports which changes the suite fails
The scope below is the arithmetic and the rules built on it: decimal money helpers,
the 28-byte memo guard, asset parsing, error classification and the router's
ranking. These are pure functions with no I/O, which is exactly where mutation
testing is cheap to run and most informative.
Not wired into pull-request CI on purpose: it re-runs the suite once per mutant and
takes minutes rather than seconds. Run it manually before a release, or on the
_comment_plugins: Named explicitly because pnpm's symlinked node_modules does not expose the
plugin to Stryker's sandbox by glob alone.
_comment_ignore: Stryker copies the project into a sandbox. The vendored agent-skill
directories are symlinks, which the copy cannot follow on Windows, and none
of these paths affect a mutation run anyway.
